summary: Iteration 11 retest of the 4 minor items from iteration_10, plus a quick regression. All items pass. Backend: test_iteration11_retest.py passed 9/9. (1) Expo app at 390x844: a TEST product with an empty tag shows no tag pill on the Jewellery card or the product-detail hero (no empty absolute element in the DOM). Tagged products still show their badge ('New' on Classic Solitaire Ring, 'Classic', 'Luxury', 'Premium' on the cards). (2) The card label reads 'Price' and the value is total_price (₹16,294 for 2g at 12% making). 'Gold value' no longer appears. (3) Audit Log: removing a banner or FAQ records the title or question as the target, for both the shop and master endpoints (API). It also works through the UI: shop banner remove, shop FAQ remove and master FAQ remove all show the text, e.g. 'Banner Removed | TEST_UI Remove Banner'. No UUIDs appear. (4) Shop SIP tab: the filter shows All/Active/Paused/Cancelled. The KPI foot reads '1 paused · 1 cancelled'. summary.total is 2 for 1 active + 1 paused + 1 cancelled, so cancelled SIPs are excluded (master too). ?status=cancelled returns only cancelled rows, and the UI shows a red 'Cancelled' badge (bg #FEF3F2, text #B42318). The Active and Paused filters are correct. (5) Regression: shop Catalogue (9 rows, product remove works) and master Overview render with no JS page errors and no 4xx/5xx. The only 404 is the expected, handled tenant/resolve call on the preview host.
